name: Bayplay Adventure
pickupPoints: Bayplay shop, 3755 Point Nepean Road, Portsea
intro: Bayplay Adventure runs guided snorkelling and other outdoor experiences from Portsea. Its current Sea Dragon tour page describes a briefing at the operator followed by a walk to the beach. Portsea Pier is closed to public access for maintenance, so confirm the current route and availability with Bayplay.
whatGoodAt: Guided marine-life experiences based in Portsea, with snorkelling equipment and a skills demonstration listed for the Sea Dragon tour. Ask the operator about water confidence and the current beach entry before booking.
notSuitedFor: The current Sea Dragon tour lists a minimum age of 12. Groups seeking a pier-based entry should confirm the route, since public access to Portsea Pier is closed.
